units.title: exam05
examples: attribute queries on a polygon layer: largest drop, largest value of a type, towns drawn as several polygons
choropleth of density with 5 quantile classes, plus 3 km buffers round points
distance from each point to its nearest point of another layer; mean by category
population density from population and area; count units above a threshold
pros and cons of equal-interval against quantile classes
read a scattergram of road miles against area; compare with density
spatial join of points to polygons; count points per polygon
straight-line distance raster to the nearest point; the farthest cell

units.title: exam_sample
examples: join a table by key; mean and standard deviation of a field for a selected subset
select polygons crossed by lines; sum attributes for the two groups and compare
why a vote-count map with natural breaks misleads; choose field, symbols and classes for a better map
why local agencies use state-plane coordinates, and how an equal-area conic changes a lat/lon map
why the mean of county percentages differs from the overall percentage
